data.fullPrompt: Shot on Hasselblad X2D 100C, 24mm tilt-shift at f/8. Balanced cvwmn bedroom with dark walnut storage bed frame centered against soft slate blue walls, warm cream linen upholstered headboard rising 48 inches. Caramel leather bench with brushed brass legs at foot of bed on rust-ochre patterned jute rug. 65 inch Samsung Frame TV wall-mounted opposite bed with dark walnut bezel. Stack of hardcover books with geometric brass air plant holder on bench. Warm morning light through cream linen curtains casting soft shadows left across bed, brushed brass sconce creating diagonal glow above headboard. Architectural Digest editorial photograph.
